en: Oh yeah, your lab opened up, right?

I wonder if I'll ever find my lab...
If that happens, I'll know my talent...

...I want to try finding my lab.
Even though I know I probably won't find it.

If it's not too much trouble,
would you help me?

<CLT=cltMIND>I spent some time searching around the
school with Rantaro...
<CLT=cltMIND>Rantaro and I grew a little closer today.
